PAGE_NOT_FOUND_DESCRIPTION: This address isn't part of Arclayer Admin. Use the navigation to return to Overview.
UNEXPECTED_DESCRIPTION: This page did not finish loading. Refresh and try again. If it keeps happening, share this page address with your Platform administrator.
PLATFORM_SETUP_STATE_UNAVAILABLE: Platform setup status could not be checked
PLATFORM_SETUP_STATE_UNAVAILABLE_RECOVER: Check the service connection and try again. Arclayer Admin won't assume setup is complete.
PLATFORM_SETUP_FAILED: The Instance Owner could not be created
PLATFORM_SETUP_FAILED_RECOVERY: Review the account details and try again. No successful setup was recorded.
INSTANCE_ALREADY_INITIALIZED_RECOVERY: Continue to Platform sign-in with the existing Instance Owner account.
INSTANCE_SETUP_REPAIR_REQUIRED_RECOVERY: Ask the deployment administrator to repair the setup records, then check setup again.
EMAIL_EXISTS: This email is already in use
EMAIL_EXISTS_RECOVERY: Use a different email address for the first Instance Owner.
USERNAME_EXISTS: This username is already in use
USERNAME_EXISTS_RECOVERY: Choose a different username for the first Instance Owner.
PLATFORM_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Email, username, or password is incorrect
PLATFORM_INVALID_CREDENTIALS_RECOVERY: Check your email or username and password, then try again.
PLATFORM_ACCESS_REQUIRED: This account does not have administrator access
PLATFORM_ACCESS_REQUIRED_RECOVERY: Use an authorized administrator account or ask the Instance Owner for access.
PLATFORM_IDENTITY_CHANGED_RECOVERY: Start sign-in again to use the account's current status.
PLATFORM_AUTH_FLOW_INVALID: This sign-in has expired or was already used
PLATFORM_AUTH_FLOW_INVALID_RECOVERY: Start sign-in again and complete security verification.
PLATFORM_NETWORK_ERROR: Arclayer Admin could not reach the service
PLATFORM_NETWORK_ERROR_RECOVERY: Check your connection and try again. Sign-in wasn't completed.
PLATFORM_SESSION_EXPIRED_RECOVERY: Sign in and complete security verification again.
PLATFORM_SESSION_REVOKED: This device was signed out of Arclayer Admin
PLATFORM_SESSION_REVOKED_RECOVERY: Sign in again. If your administrator access was removed, ask the Instance Owner for help.
SECURITY_KEY_REQUIRED: A security key or passkey is required
SECURITY_KEY_REQUIRED_RECOVERY: Add or recover a security key or passkey before continuing.
SECURITY_KEY_UNAVAILABLE_RECOVERY: This required security check can't be completed right now. Contact the deployment administrator; access wasn't granted.
SECURITY_KEY_CANCELLED_RECOVERY: Keep this page open and try the security key or passkey again.
PLATFORM_CODE_INVALID_RECOVERY: Enter the current code from your authenticator app and try again.
PLATFORM_AUTH_UNEXPECTED_RECOVERY: Start sign-in again. This attempt wasn't completed.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_TRIAGE_REVISION_CONFL: Another operator changed this item's work status first. Your change was not applied.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_SOURCE_RESOLVED: The responsible service confirmed this issue is resolved. Work status is now read-only.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_ALREADY_CLAIMED: Another operator already claimed this item. Your change was not applied.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_ASSIGNEE_REQUIRED: Assign this item before marking work in progress.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_ASSIGNEE_INELIGIBLE: The selected operator is no longer available for assignment. Your change was not applied.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_REMINDER_INVALID: Choose a future reminder time and provide a reason. Your change was not applied.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_NOT_FOUND: This item no longer exists or you can't view it.
PLATFORM_OPERATIONS_REQUEST_FAILED: This request couldn't be completed. Nothing was changed.
PLATFORM_OPERATIONS_RESPONSE_INVALID: The service returned a result that couldn't be used. Nothing was changed.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_INELIGIBLE: This workspace isn't eligible for this capability.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ELIGIBILITY_UNREGIS: This capability has no registered workspace eligibility rule.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_CAPABILITY_: The capability definition changed. Generate a new rollout preview.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_ELIGIBILITY: The eligible workspace scope changed. Generate a new rollout preview.
The workspace eligibility rules changed. Generate a new rollout preview.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_IDEMPOTENCY: This rollout request identifier was already used for another operation.
This rollout request identifier does not match the original operation.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_NOT_AVAILAB: This capability isn't currently available for this workspace.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_NOT_SELECTE: This workspace hasn't been selected for this capability rollout.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_POLICY_STAL: The rollout policy changed. Generate a new rollout preview.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_PREVIEW_EXP: The rollout preview expired. Generate a new preview.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_PREVIEW_NOT: The rollout preview could not be found. Generate a new preview.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_SELECTED_WO: One or more selected workspaces are no longer eligible for this capability.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_UNSUPPORTED: This capability does not support workspace rollout.
WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY_ROLLOUT_WORKSPACE_N: One or more selected workspaces could not be found.
AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY_REQUIRED_FOR_CONNECT: Re-enter the service API key when changing connection settings.
AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY_REQUIRED_FOR_LITELLM: Re-enter the upstream API key when changing the model ID or endpoint.
AI_PROVIDER_ARCHIVED_CANNOT_ENABLE: Archived AI services cannot be enabled. Restore the service first.
AI_PROVIDER_ARCHIVE_REQUIRES_DISABLED: Disable the AI service before archiving it.
AI_PROVIDER_AVAILABILITY_PREVIEW_REQUIRE: Generate an impact preview before changing AI service availability.
AI_PROVIDER_AVAILABILITY_PREVIEW_STALE: The AI service impact preview is stale. Generate a new preview before applying the change.
AI_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_REVOCATION_PORT_U: This deployment cannot safely revoke the previous credential, so provider credentials cannot currently be rotated or removed.
AI_PROVIDER_DEFAULT_MODEL_NOT_MAPPED: The default model must match one of the configured model mappings.
AI_PROVIDER_DELETE_REQUIRES_ARCHIVE: Archive and disable the AI service before deleting it.
AI_PROVIDER_ICON_VARIANTS_REQUIRED: Configure both light and dark theme icons, or clear both.
AI_PROVIDER_LITELLM_CLEANUP_FAILED: The AI service could not finish cleanup. Try again later or contact your Platform administrator.
AI_PROVIDER_LITELLM_CLEANUP_REQUIRED: The AI service still needs cleanup. Retry the removal before continuing.
AI_PROVIDER_LITELLM_KEY_MISSING: The AI service did not finish setup. Try connecting it again.
AI_PROVIDER_LITELLM_MASTER_KEY_REQUIRED: The AI service cannot be connected until deployment setup is complete.
AI_PROVIDER_LITELLM_PROVISION_FAILED: The AI service could not be connected. Check the service key, address, and model, then try again.
AI_PROVIDER_MASTER_KEY_REQUIRED: System key storage is not configured, so the AI service cannot be saved.
AI_PROVIDER_MODEL_MAPPING_DUPLICATE: Public model identifiers must be unique.
AI_PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: The AI service does not exist or was already deleted.
AI_PROVIDER_PUBLIC_MODEL_CONFLICT: This public model name is already used by another AI service. Give each service a unique public model name.
AI_PROVIDER_READINESS_RESPONSE_MISMATCH: The connection succeeded, but the test response did not match the expectation. Check the test prompt, expected text, and model configuration.
AI_PROVIDER_READINESS_TEST_FAILED: The AI service connection test failed. Check the API key, endpoint, and model configuration.
AI_PROVIDER_REQUIRED_FIELDS: Enter the service name, provider, API key, at least one complete model mapping, and a default model.
AI_PROVIDER_STORED_API_KEY_UNAVAILABLE: This AI service was saved without a reusable encrypted upstream credential. Re-enter the API key once to save this connection change.
AI_PROVIDER_ROUTABLE: At least one enabled AI service with a successful connection test is required to process requests.
AI_PROVIDER_UPDATED_CLEANUP_REQUIRED: The AI service was updated, but the previous setup still needs cleanup. Retry the operation.
AI_MODEL_CATALOG_PROVIDER_CONFLICT: Multiple AI services use the same public model name. Give each service a unique public model name in Platform Console.
PROVIDER_MODEL_CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT: Multiple AI services use the requested public model name. Give each service a unique public model name in Platform Console.
